title: Federal Direct Loan annual limits - undergraduate basics
facts: For dependent undergraduate students, combined annual Direct Subsidized and Unsubsidized Loan limits are generally $5,500 for first year, $6,500 for second year and $7,500 for third year and beyond, with lower sublimits on subsidized amounts.

Independent undergraduates and certain dependent students whose parents cannot obtain PLUS may generally have higher combined annual limits: $9,500 first year, $10,500 second year and $12,500 third year and beyond.
Aggregate limits and special rules also apply, so the annual maximum is not necessarily the amount a student can or should borrow.
